mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather. We are looking at 63 degrees with overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park, plus a full moon tonight. Looking ahead, the temperature will drop to 59 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has issued a scam alert regarding fake requests for planning and zoning fees; please remember that all official city emails end in at veronawi dot gov. Additionally, city crews are preparing for fall leaf collection which begins October 5, so please keep loose leaves behind the curb.

We have plenty going on in town today, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing. Looking to tomorrow, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard, check out the popular Verona Fall Fest at Hometown USA Festival Park, or enjoy music at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a noteworthy call from September 10, police responded to a burglary in the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way where an individual was detained and treated for injuries sustained during the incident.
Culver's is currently open, but hurry in because they are closing in 52 minutes for a scheduled remodel.
